name: Three-Act
description: The classic shape: set the story up, complicate it, resolve it.

acts.title: Setup
acts.description: Who, where, and what normal looks like until it breaks.

beats.name: Hook
beats.hint: Open with something that makes the reader lean in: a question, a tension, a voice.

beats.name: Inciting incident
beats.hint: The event that disrupts the protagonist's normal and starts the story moving.

beats.name: First plot point
beats.hint: The protagonist commits; from here there is no going back.

acts.title: Confrontation
acts.description: Obstacles escalate while the protagonist tries, fails and adapts.

beats.name: Rising action
beats.hint: Each attempt costs more; allies and enemies take shape.

beats.name: Midpoint
beats.hint: A reversal or revelation that changes the stakes or what the protagonist understands.

beats.name: Second plot point
beats.hint: The lowest point, or the discovery that sets up the final confrontation.

acts.title: Resolution
acts.description: The central conflict is faced and settled.

beats.name: Climax
beats.hint: The protagonist meets the central conflict head-on, using what they have learned.

beats.name: Resolution
beats.hint: The new normal: what changed, and what it cost.
